direction: 2D anime painted backgrounds inspired by the observed SAO Minecraft website, native game models and inventory remain unchanged

assets.role: server landscape silhouettes only, interpreted in 2D

prompts.aincrad:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 illustrated backdrop for the Nameless Sword Art Online Minecraft website.
Input image 1: reference for ANIME BACKGROUND PAINTING LANGUAGE and recognizable Aincrad identity only. Do not copy this scene or the rider. Input image 2: reference for the server's believable landscape and tiered architectural silhouettes, translated into 2D painting, NOT a voxel screenshot.
Primary request: A new, beautifully composed 2D anime background of Aincrad. Looking from a shaded stone garden terrace toward a peaceful green valley and a small circular walled town with simple terracotta roofs. Above the distant valley on the RIGHT half, the iconic immense Aincrad fortress floats in clouds: a clearly designed inverted-cone mountain of broad stacked inhabited levels, tapering downward, with three large horizontal tiers and slender structural towers attached to each tier. It is Aincrad from Sword Art Online, not an ordinary medieval castle placed on a chunk of rock. Depict this with a clean understandable silhouette rather than hundreds of ornamental towers.
Medium: authentically anime-like painted background plate. Elegant economical ink contour where appropriate, gouache-like flat color masses, hand-painted sky and foliage, broad 2D shadow shapes, soft atmospheric distance, restrained edge detail. Deliberately drafted architecture. The image should feel like a carefully finished background from an animated fantasy episode. NO 3D rendering, no ray-traced voxel texture, no cinematic concept-art gloss.
Composition: left 38% contains a quiet shaded tree canopy and dark, simply constructed angular stone terrace for website copy. Town in lower middle distance; Aincrad focal silhouette upper right (x65–82%, y15–48%). Generous open sky around silhouette. Three depth planes clearly separated. No people or animals. The terrace uses a few stepped Minecraft-like slabs, drawn as simple 2D shapes; do not tile every surface with little blocks.
Color/light: soft late afternoon light, muted celadon greens, blue-grey shade, ivory clouds, small terracotta roof accents and restrained honey light. Calm clear painterly colors, navy-compatible shadow areas. No orange/teal grading.
Constraints: new original illustration, no reproduction of the rider, no characters, no logos, no text, no UI, no watermark. No random micro-spires, glitter, noisy texture, magical crystals, warped bridges or melted rooflines. Do not use blur filters to disguise bad drawing; foreground should be intentionally drawn, distant details simplified by painting. Prioritize anime painting, purposeful shapes and identifiable Aincrad silhouette.
prompts.forest:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 anime painted environment for the Nameless SAO Minecraft Bestiary header.
Input image 1: STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE ONLY. Match its 2D painted anime background language, controlled foliage shapes, matte colors and carefully drafted stone forms. Do not include Aincrad or copy the valley scene.
Primary request: A quiet forest clearing in Aincrad painted as a beautiful background from a Japanese fantasy animation. An old simple stone gateway with a stepped lintel stands at the right, beyond a short, clearly constructed set of wide stone steps. A shallow blue-grey stream runs along the path. Three strong tree trunks and a broad dark leaf canopy frame the left and upper edge; sunlit grasses and a small patch of white flowers open toward the right distance. A single restrained amber lantern is fastened to the stone gate. No creatures.
Medium: 2D anime background painting with gouache-like color planes, occasional fine ink edges, purposeful shadow shapes, lush but clearly grouped foliage. No 3D model rendering, no shader screenshot, no photorealistic texture, no pixel tiling. The architecture can be built in Minecraft: angular stone slabs, attached steps and modular lintel, but interpreted with drawn 2D forms rather than showing thousands of cubes.
Composition: panoramic, left 40% calm darker trunks and shadow for website copy, gateway focal point in right half. Stream and path both visibly continue through the scene. Three depth planes, soft cool distance. Keep key gateway and lantern near y50%, readable after shallow banner cropping.
Light/color: subdued celadon and forest greens, blue-grey stone, ivory daylight filtered through canopy; limited warm ochre accents. Painterly gentle light without dramatic bloom or excessive contrast.
Constraints: no people, animals, logos, monograms, signs, text, UI or watermark. No castle, no glowing crystals, no random sparks, no tiny ornamental fragments, no tangled geometry or melted stones. Crisp deliberately painted foreground edges, simplified distant foliage.
prompts.guild:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 anime painted interior for the Nameless SAO Minecraft guild page.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the new 2D Aincrad painting's careful draughtsmanship, gouache-like color masses, anime background finish and blue-grey shadows. Make a completely new interior, do not replicate the outdoor scene.
Primary request: A welcoming guild meeting room in Aincrad, drawn and painted as a high-quality 2D background from a fantasy anime. A modest rectangular room of blue-grey stone and straight oak beams. One supported upper gallery along the left wall, four square piers, two plain navy banners, two simple wooden tables near the sides, and a small meeting table on a three-step platform at the back right. Rectangular windows let in calm honey afternoon light. This is a purposeful built room, not a cathedral or throne chamber.
Medium: clearly hand-drawn-looking 2D anime environment illustration with economical ink edges, matte watercolor/gouache fill and broad painted shadows. Soft distant edges, selected crisp foreground contours. Do not emulate 3D voxel rendering or realistic shader textures. Keep modular stone courses and angular wooden architecture compatible with a Minecraft-inspired world, but paint their surfaces in simple broad planes.
Composition: panorama at eye level, rigorous shared perspective. Left third quiet shaded wall/table space for page copy. Windows, platform and focal table on right half. Four amber lanterns at most, all attached to sensible supports. Main furniture sits around y60–75% so it can be cropped intentionally. The window shapes remain straight and consistent.
Palette: soft grey-blue stone, muted oak brown, deep navy fabric, ivory glass light and restrained warm gold. Warmth is localized, no orange filter.
Constraints: no people, animals, logos, Nameless emblems, writing, UI or watermark. Banners blank. Every table and chair has straight attached legs; beams are supported. No random props, luminous dust, tiny glowing dots, chandelier forest, endless pillars, nonsensical balconies, warped windows, shiny CGI or high-frequency texture noise.
prompts.workshop:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide 16:9 anime painted interior background for the Nameless SAO Minecraft Items catalogue.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the 2D painted anime draughtsmanship, controlled matte colors, broad shadows and carefully designed architecture. Do not copy the landscape.
Primary request: A quiet artisan workshop in Aincrad, painted as an original background from an animated fantasy episode. Grey-blue stone walls, straight warm oak rafters, one stout four-legged wooden workbench on the right, one closed wooden chest beneath it, and one unmistakable dark iron anvil mounted on a solid wooden stump. A modest stone forge hearth occupies the far right with a small amber fire. A high rectangular window admits ivory daylight. The left wall is largely plain and shaded, with one small empty navy cloth. This is a functional, uncluttered room.
Medium: clearly 2D anime environment painting, economical fine drawing edges and matte gouache/watercolor-like filled planes. Thoughtful sharp and soft edge choices, hand-painted stone and oak with very restrained surface marks. Minecraft-compatible angular modular architecture translated into a painted scene; no 3D voxel shader, ray tracing or hyperrealistic material.
Composition: consistent eye-level perspective, left 40% simple dark wall for copy, three functional stations readable on right half. Workbench, chest, anvil and fire remain visible around y55–78% for shallow website banner crop. Keep the anvil's broad flat top, horn and squared base structurally clear. One lantern securely sits on the bench; no other small props. Only plain sky and distant greenery through the window.
Color/light: blue-grey shadows, muted natural oak, small honey light area at the hearth and window. Calm modest workshop atmosphere. Flat controlled light masses; no global orange cast.
Constraints: no people, characters, creatures, weapons, text, symbols, logos, UI or watermark. No excessive loot, glass bottles, magical crystals, luminous dust, cluttered shelves, wobbly furniture, melted metal or over-detailed CGI surfaces. The chest has one latch and the table has straight solid joined legs.
